snippet.title: Project Rhombus - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Project Rhombus on Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/735570/Project_Rhombus

Project Rhombus is a rhythm-based casual action game that combines exciting electronic music with stylish flat design. Hold on as long as possible, blocking the oncoming arrows moving to the beat.

© PsychoFlux Entertainment. © SEROSOO. Some rights reserved. Music composed by Hinkik and A Himitsu.
